title: The Judicial Reforms of 2023 and the 2026 Election
grammar: Recap: reporting what someone stated with azt mondta, hogy
goal: I can report what the government and the Commission stated about the amendments of 2023 (*módosítás, teljesül, felszabadít*).
I can report a statement with *azt közölte, hogy* and *azt állapította meg, hogy*.
I can give the dated events of 2026: the election of 12 April, the election of the prime minister on 9 May and the amendment of July.
